Welcome—let’s set off together on a journey where the landscape is more than just a backdrop. Imagine Cornwall: shaped by restless winds, the pull of the sea, and the silent wisdom of ancient stones. Here, every view is a doorway to deeper questions about how we see the world—and how the world sees us.
That’s the heart of View Points and Points of View: A 'Phoetry Book' from Cornwall by Clive Blake. As we explore these pages, you’ll notice how the boundaries between images and words start to blur. Suddenly, a photograph isn’t just a moment captured, and a verse isn’t just a line on a page—they blend together, pulling us into a space where perception and reality dance.
Picture the Cornish coast: shifting light, centuries-old stories etched into rugged cliffs, and a quiet magic that almost begs you to slow down. This place becomes our canvas, inviting us to notice how every shift in perspective—every change in angle or mood—can reveal something new, something extraordinary hiding in plain sight.
As we move forward, you’ll find that poetry and photography don’t just sit side by side—they speak to each other. The rhythm of tides, the texture of weathered stone, even the fleeting glances of people passing by… they all become part of a gentle meditation on what it means to look, to feel, and to truly see.
Together, we’ll discover how every scene holds countless stories—just waiting to be seen from a new angle. There’s richness in every moment, and Clive Blake’s work invites us to pause, notice, and let our own perceptions shift. So, let’s open our eyes—and our minds—to the beauty and meaning waiting for us in Cornwall’s quiet corners.
